summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for acute hypoxemic respiratory failure due to recurrent tracheal and bronchial stenosis from Ruvalcaba-Myhre-Smith syndrome and relapsing polychondritis. He presented with sudden shortness of breath and cyanosis at home, requiring EMS transport. He was stabilized with oxygen and nebulizers, then underwent bronchoscopy with balloon dilation of the trachea and bilateral mainstem bronchi, which improved his airway patency and oxygenation. His leukocytosis resolved without antibiotics, and pain was managed with oxycodone. He was restarted on home medications, including tobramycin nebulizers and Esbriet, with a new nebulizer provided. He was discharged home with follow-up planned in one month for repeat bronchoscopy and continued management of chronic conditions.
